$comment: Canonical registry for MindAttic.Deploy. Three arrays: `projects` is README-driven landing pages at mindattic.com/<slug>.htm (rendered via template/index.template.htm); `sites` is verbatim root-site FTP uploads (mindattic.com root, mindatticcares.com, ryandebraal.com); `apps` is Blazor / GitHub-Actions-driven deploys (StreetSamurai today; IdiotProof/TaxRateCollector/ThinkTank/Tutor stubbed pending infra). Build/Deploy = node src/build.js / src/deploy.js. componentsVersion pins the jsDelivr tag for MindAttic.UIUX (Components and Themes both come from this ref). 'main' = tip-of-tree (current default): live pages can shift when UiUx changes and jsDelivr caches 'main' for ~12h, so rollouts are not atomic. For production stability, pin an immutable tag — but it MUST contain the current Themes/<Theme>/{deps.json,theme.css} layout. NOTE: the existing 'v1.0.0' tag predates that layout (Themes/ and the Components/ rename are all post-v1.0.0), so pinning it would 404 every page's CSS. Cut a fresh tag from UiUx main first, then set it here. (Now pinned to 'v1.0.1', cut from UiUx main on 2026-05-28 — it contains the current Themes/ layout and the Cyberspace console-bg.js + circuitboard textures that mindattic.com loads from jsDelivr.) Each project picks a theme via the 'theme' field; valid values match folder names under MindAttic.UIUX/Themes/ (currently: Cyberspace — the sole theme; the Hardware doc theme was retired 2026-05-29 and ChiMesh/Claudia moved to Cyberspace). AUTO-DISCOVERY: build.js also auto-generates a Cyberspace landing page for EVERY public non-archived mindattic repo with a README (via `gh repo list`), excluding infra (MindAttic.Deploy, MindAttic.UiUx) and repos with no README. The `projects` entries below are the CURATED overrides (title/tagline/openUrl/addon); discovered repos not listed here get title=repo, tagline=GitHub description. Pass --no-discover to build only the curated list. ADDONS: an entry may set 'addon' (e.g. "parts") to layer an interactive section onto the standard README page — today only "parts" (ChiMesh/Claudia build picker), driven by src/parts.js reading the repo's config/parts.json.

apps.disabledNote: Workflow targets `idiotproof-web` App Service. Needs Azure infrastructure + AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE secret in mindattic/IdiotProof. Set `disabled: false` once those exist.
Workflow targets `taxratecollector` App Service. Needs Azure infrastructure + AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE secret in mindattic/TaxRateCollector. Set `disabled: false` once those exist.
No workflow yet. Add .github/workflows/azure-deploy.yml (mirror StreetSamurai's pattern), provision an Azure App Service, add AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE secret, then set `disabled: false`.
